properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's second real-site pass: real OpenStreetMap building footprint for One Mission Bay, a 350-unit, two-building (a 13-16 story tower plus a 6-story perimeter building, sources disagree on the tower's exact story count) waterfront condominium development at 110 Channel St/1000 3rd St, developed by CIM Group and Strada Investment Group, designed by Arquitectonica, completed 2018. Point-in-polygon checked against DataSF's official redevelopment-area layer: this site falls in Mission Bay South, not Mission Bay North as this project's own brief informally grouped it.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same real-geometry-without-a-single-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.
properties.notes: This footprint is the taller tower component only (OSM way 563104192); the lower 6-story perimeter building is not separately mapped with a name tag in the data fetched here.
